notes: Hubtel's messaging API authored from developers.hubtel.com (docs only; Hubtel's Swagger endpoints answer 403). The adaptor is an SMS adaptor: sendSMS() POSTs {From, To, Content} to {baseUrl}/messages/send with Basic auth (clientId:clientSecret), and request() reaches any path under that baseUrl, so 'full' here means the whole documented messaging surface: 6 SMS operations (GET quick send with URL credentials, POST send, batch simple, batch personalised, message status, batch status) on sms.hubtel.com/v1 (business; smsc.hubtel.com/v1 serves the personal-account subset with the same paths), plus the 3 OTP operations on api-otp.hubtel.com, modelled with a path-level server. Hubtel's payment, lending, verification and other product APIs are separate services on other hosts and are not reachable through this adaptor's configuration; they are out of scope. The July stub's getMessageStatus path and Status/MessageId/Rate/NetworkId response were not what the docs show (the real fields are camelCase rate/messageId/status/networkId/clientReference/statusDescription) and have been replaced. Error bodies are not sampled in the docs; SmsError is the documented status/statusDescription pair. OTP verify returns no body. Phone numbers, sender names and personal names in samples are replaced with placeholders.
